Name: (AT) HxW Outdoor Furniture Recolor Mega Pack
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][center]As if you needed another reason to download our furniture packs, we now have [color=#ff0000]R[/color][color=#ff7700]E[/color][color=#ffff00]C[/color][color=#00ff00]O[/color][color=#00ffff]L[/color][color=#0000ff]O[/color][color=#9900ff]R[/color][color=#ff00ff]S[/color]!!

This is an Alternative Textures Pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16693]Hime and Wildflour's Outdoor Furniture[/url]﻿. Simply download, make sure you have Alternative Textures installed, and enjoy over a dozen recolors!

[b][b]🌺 [/b]What's included:
[/b]
Dark and white wood variants of all the items
Flower/cushion color changes for each as well in lavender, blue, pale pink, yellow, and a white/black version for our more chic decorators.
Big trees with seating also come in their classic foliage as well as a cherry pink, dark green, and white or red depending on the bark chosen.
